column3: Kirino flipped out, spat out those words and, leaving me behind, disappeared into the crowds.
Well, doesn't this mean I've been given my freedom?
Hey, you... Do you have a moment?
I looked up and suddenly there was a security guard standing in front of me, blocking my way.
Earlier, someone reported that there was a person holding a suspicious package. Is it okay if I examine you?
Ack! Why is there a suspicious doujin in the shopping bag?!
And the title is, "Perverted Phoenix Temple Jade Department Play?!"
If you think about it, there can only be one cause of this.
Kirino snuck that doujin in with the bags to get back at me!
Or rather, how long have I been holding this?!
